prompts.title: Mûsâ'nın Tuvâ vadisine gelişi
prompts.prompt:
Cinematic historical visualization inspired by the Quranic account of Prophet Moses
approaching the sacred valley of Tuwa.

Ancient Sinai-like mountainous desert landscape at night, rugged dark mountains,
rocky valley, distant warm mysterious light, a lone traveler approaching from the distance.

The environment should feel ancient, remote and realistic.

Prophet Moses must not have an identifiable face. Show him as a distant silhouette from behind.

Natural moonlight, subtle atmospheric haze, cinematic wide shot, historical documentary realism.

AI-generated visualization, not a historical photograph.
prompts.negativePrompt: modern buildings, modern vehicles, modern clothing, fantasy elements, text, watermark, subtitles, fantasy creatures

prompts.title: Mûsâ'nın Tuvâ vadisine gelişi (10 sn)
prompts.prompt:
10-second cinematic historical visualization inspired by the Quranic story of Moses
approaching the sacred valley.

Camera slowly moves forward through a dark rocky desert valley at night.
A distant human silhouette approaches a mysterious source of light.
Wind moves the clothing and dust gently.
Large ancient mountains surround the valley.

Prophet Moses is seen only from behind and at a distance. No identifiable face.

Cinematic historical realism. AI-generated historical visualization.
